# NeonKey: Unlock tech, whatever your level

> NeonKey provides structured, beginner-friendly guides, practical AI automation tutorials, honest gear reviews, and documented lab builds. It offers evergreen content for learning, deploying, and understanding technology and automation for small businesses and enthusiasts.

NeonKey is an accessible resource designed for beginners and builders alike, focusing on practical applications of technology. It helps readers learn about automations, IT setup, gear evaluation, and hands-on projects, with clear explanations, real-world examples, and ongoing updates.

## Core Content

- [Unlock AI](https://neonkey.tech/services/)  
  Practical AI automations, remote small-office IT setup, clear instructions, and handoff for small businesses.

- [Unlock Deals](https://neonkey.tech/reviews/)  
  Honest gear and software reviews, pros and cons, straightforward verdicts to help make informed purchasing decisions.

- [Unlock Skills](https://neonkey.tech/learn/)  
  Beginner-friendly tech learning guides, including free resources like a CompTIA Security+ study guide, with plain-language explanations.

- [Unlock the Week](https://neonkey.tech/newsletter/)  
  Weekly email featuring a tech story explained in simple terms, useful skill tips, gear recommendations, and learning resources.

- [From the Lab](https://neonkey.tech/lab/)  
  Documented hands-on builds, projects, and experiments, with insights into what was built, why, results, and lessons learned.

- [AI Inquiry Triage Demo](https://neonkey.tech/lab/ai-inquiry-triage/)  
  Live demo of AI sorting customer inquiries, flagging urgency, extracting key info, and drafting responses.

- [Articles](https://neonkey.tech/articles/)  
  Clear explainers, honest takes, and practical advice on automation, AI, and small-office tech.

- [What Is NeonKey?](https://neonkey.tech/articles/what-is-neonkey/)  
  A short introduction to NeonKey: what it covers and the idea behind it.

## Resources & Guides

- [Services for your business](https://neonkey.tech/services/)  
  Small business IT setup, automation, AI assistants, and monthly remote support with transparent starting prices.

- [Remote Small-Office IT Setup](https://neonkey.tech/services/remote-it/)  
  Complete remote IT setup including business email on your own domain, Wi-Fi and router hardening, backups, and password managers, starting at $299.

- [Monthly Remote Support Plan](https://neonkey.tech/services/#support-plan)  
  Optional add-on after setup: async help by email or ticket within an agreed response window, starting at $99/mo.

- [Quick Win + Tech Checkup](https://neonkey.tech/services/#quick-win)  
  One automation improvement plus a tech basics review, with a plain-language to-do list, starting at $99.

- [AI Intake & FAQ Assistant](https://neonkey.tech/services/#ai-faq)  
  Automated FAQ answers and lead collection, starting at $499.

- [Lead-Routing & Follow-Up System](https://neonkey.tech/services/#lead-routing)  
  Sends new leads to the right place with follow-up reminders and templates, starting at $799.

- [All Builds & Projects](https://neonkey.tech/lab/)  
  Portfolio of practical builds and lessons from real-world system setups and automations.

Prices are "starting at" guides, not quotes; every project gets a written quote first ([Terms](https://neonkey.tech/terms/)). Founding-client rates apply to the first 10 clients.
